bundled.name: FFmpeg
bundled.note: Shipped inside Remotion's compositor and used for transcoding, frame sampling and audio conversion. Built with --enable-gpl, --enable-libx264 and --enable-libx265, which places the binary and its libav* libraries under the GPL. Source: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
